Recess puts your flashcards in front of the apps stealing your focus. Instagram, TikTok, and the rest wait behind a study gate until you have done the work. Then your recess is earned, and you can scroll guilt free.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Send Recess your notes, a PDF, or your slides. Recess builds a clean deck of flashcards and quizzes in seconds, with multiple choice, true or false, and fill in the blank questions.
2. Pick the apps that pull you away and set a daily study goal.
3. When you open a gated app, a flashcard appears first. Answer it to get through.
4. Build a streak. Watch your recall climb. Turn dead scroll time into real reps.

WHAT YOUR SUBSCRIPTION KEEPS RUNNING
Recess Pro is a study service, not a one time download. Your subscription pays for work that happens every time you use it:
- AI deck generation that runs on our servers, turning new notes, PDFs, and slides into flashcards all semester long
- An exam ramp that reschedules your reps as each test date gets closer, so the work builds early instead of piling up the night before
- A web companion at studyrecess.com/create for sending files from your computer straight into the app
- Spaced repetition scheduling that keeps adapting to whatever you keep forgetting

WHY RECESS IS DIFFERENT
Willpower is not enough, and you already know it. Recess is the external force you actually needed. It takes the app you cannot put down and puts your studying in front of it, so the thing that used to wreck your focus now protects it.

Recess is on your side. It is not a lecture, not a punishment, and not a productivity guru yelling at you. It is a warm nudge that gives you permission to relax once you have earned it.

MADE FOR STUDENTS
Whether you are cramming for a midterm, grinding pre med or nursing prereqs, keeping a 4.0, or just learning something new, Recess fits the way you already use your phone. High school, college, and self learners use it to turn idle scrolling into study time.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
- AI flashcards from your notes, PDFs, and slides
- Three question types: multiple choice, true or false, and fill in the blank
- Quiz Me and Practice Test modes to check your recall
- The study gate: distracting apps wait behind your flashcards

results.description:
How do you play?
Name a movie. Now, name an actor in that movie. Then, name a different movie with that actor. Keep going until someone gets out. And, that’s it!

However, let’s say someone (Charlie) gets stumped, then he can use a hint (1 per turn). If Charlie gets stuck again, he can challenge the player who came right before him (Rose). If Rose answers correctly, then Charlie is out. If Rose answers incorrectly, then she is out! In games with multiple players, you keep going until only one player remains.  
 
What are the rules?
#1 You cannot repeat an actor or a movie. 
 #2 Each player gets only one hint per game.
 #3 You can challenge as many times as you want.
 
Many ways to play
In this app, we provide multiple ways to play with your friends, family, or neighbors with uncanny abilities at recalling obscure films.

Compete: Play others 1 vs 1 in turn based games. Play with 20, 30, 60 seconds or unlimited time.

Pass N’ Play: In this multiplayer version, add your friend’s names and play! 

Bots: Challenge our movie bots to 1 vs 1 games. When you are ready for a challenge, try Daryl or Halle!

Practice: See how far you can go by yourself stringing movies and actors together!

Puzzle: Can you get from Tom Hanks to Angelina Jolie in 12 moves? Prove it! 

Practice: Brush up daily on your knowledge of actors, actresses, and movies.
 
Popcorn is delicious… and useful
Bags of popcorn are the currency of the game. Use popcorn to purchase hints or extra games. Everyone gets 1 free Pass N’ Play game per day (This includes all players and hints for each player). Additional plays cost 1 bag of popcorn. In Compete, everyone gets 3 active games at any given time. To launch more games, pay one bag of popcorn. Hints costs one bag of popcorn as well. What can we say, we love popcorn. 

An icon in the top right corner shows you how much popcorn you have left. Every player starts out with a large stash of popcorn. When you use it up, head to the concession stand to purchase more popcorn. Or purchase the Director’s Chair subscription for unlimited hints and games all month long. It’s super comfy and you’ll feel full of artistic vision.
 
Things to remember

Crammer lets you create unlimited flashcards, decks and folders for every subject for free. It's the most efficient way to memorize your study material before quizzes and exams. It drastically improves your learning speed. It uses an advanced spaced repetition and smart active recall algorithm to ensure that you review flashcards right before you may forget them. After reviewing a flashcard, you tap it to reveal the answer on the back of the card. You swipe right if you easily remembered it, left if you forgot it, or down if it took some effort and would like to review again. Crammer's algorithm will show you harder cards first and more often to help you really optimize your memory and prevent you from forgetting your study materials. Practice it a few times before your quizzes and exams to remember the study material.

Here's how to use Crammer in your studies:

- Create flashcards by either manually typing the Front and Back of the card or importing multiple cards in a long text (Front & Back separated by 3 hyphens --- and each card separated by 3 equal signs ===).

The Front can have your question and the Back can have the answer.

The Front & Back text supports Markdown and also LaTeX for Math formulas. So you can format text such as bold, italics, text color, text highlight, headings, links, images etc. You can also include diagrams (photos) in it.

To use coloured text, use curly bracket format:
{red}coloured text{}
or
{#FF0000}coloured text{}

To highlight text, use square bracket format:
[red]highlighted text[]
or
[#FF0000]highlighted text[]

- Organize your flashcards into decks and folders for each subject as needed. Cards can belong to multiple decks at the same time. Decks and folders can also have subdecks and subfolders.

- Practice decks or just bookmarked cards.

- After reviewing the question on the front of the card, tap the card to flip it and reveal the answer on the back. Swipe RIGHT if the card was easy, LEFT if it you forgot it, or DOWN if you remembered but took some effort and would like to review again.

- Once the whole deck is practiced, Crammer tells you how long you took to practice, and how many cards were hard.

- Once you have reviewed a deck, you can instantly practice again with just a single tap.

- Crammer notifies you if there's some card which you are constantly failing as it might be poorly designed. You can edit it to improve it. Make sure to swipe and reset its practice history after such fixes.

- Swipe/Right Click on Mac to Bookmark important cards, decks, and folders for easy access.

- Swipe/Right Click on Mac to Archive cards, decks, and folders which you no longer need.

- Supports multiple choice questions (e.g. a, b, c, d). Use "1." before each option in markdown and it will automatically be rendered as a list of options. A setting lets you switch between numerical or alphabetical options.

- All your decks, folders, and flashcards are seamlessly auto-synced across all your devices using iCloud. So you can create them on iPad/Mac and access them on iPhone.

- All features are free. No Ads. No subscriptions.

- Crammer is available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Supported keyboard shortcuts on Mac:
- Enter or Spacebar to flip card
- Left, Down and Right arrow keys for Hard, Again, and Easy ratings
- Command + Z to undo a rating and go back to previous card
- When editing a card, right click text to add photo

Crews is body doubling that doesn't stop at the timer.

Join a live session, say what you're working on, and work next to people who show up at the same times you do. Camera on or off, voice or chat only. When the fifty minutes are up, the room doesn't empty out – and neither does the crew you found in it.

WHAT A SESSION IS

A timed room with real people in it. Check in with what you're doing, focus together, check out with what you finished. The phases are marked, so a change of pace is something you feel rather than discover.

• Live video and mic, both optional – a chat-only session is a real choice, not a fallback • Session goals come from your own task list; tick one off and it posts as a win • Observer seats: when the verbal seats are gone, slip in quietly and still work alongside familiar faces. Never a hard no. • A short reflection at the end – how the room felt, what helped – that adds up into a picture of how you actually work

CREWS, NOT STRANGERS

This is the part that never got better anywhere else. You meet someone who makes your Tuesday work, and then you never see them again.

• Crews are groups that persist: chat, members, a schedule, pages worth reading • The conversation outlives the timer — crew chat between sessions, session chat open after it • Regulars you recognize, follows, profiles, and a feed of what your people finished • Boost a crew you're part of and the whole crew gets more: its own banner and color, more pages, more seats

YOUR WORK, IN THE ROOM

• Projects and tasks that live where the sessions are, not in a second app • Every list in one view, or one list at a time — fold away what isn't today • Unfinished work carries into the next session instead of quietly disappearing

MUSIC AND PRESENCE

• Hear the room's music, with the level in your hands — voices always come first • A status your crew can see: what you're working on, what you're listening to, whether you're heads-down

ON YOUR WRIST AND YOUR LOCK SCREEN

• Apple Watch: the timer, mute, and leave, without picking up your phone • Live Activities: the session phase on your lock screen • Minimize the app and the audio keeps running

WHY IT EXISTS

Crews came out of 15,000 hours spent inside body-doubling tools by someone who loved them and watched them stay frozen: the chat that died with the timer, the great co-worker you never saw again, the "room full" wall in front of a host worth showing up for.

Free to join, with five sessions a month. Membership adds unlimited sessions, hosting your own, bigger task lists, and boosts to spend on your crews. Crews runs on the web and the Mac too, and your sessions, crews and tasks stay in sync wherever you sign in.
